reason: Place the rocky world in the disk to begin following it through the remaining stones.
expectation: The world and its moon will be situated in the thinning disk, possibly setting up an encounter with debris.

alternatives.reason: The debris collision also addresses a goal, but I want to follow the rocky world first.

effect: The rocky world has passed through the remaining stones, completing that goal; I can now follow the debris and material leaving the disk.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the tracked world survive as part of a wider system.
reason: The debris encounter directly follows the remaining material between the planets.
expectation: Fast bodies will strike the mixed debris, probably breaking some into smaller fragments.

alternatives.reason: The exposed gas may show how material leaves the disk, but I want to follow the debris first.

effect: The collision leaves a mixed debris population between the planets; I still need to follow material leaving the disk.
reaction: I appreciated the link back to the inward icy body's remains.
reason: The exposed gas seems a direct way to follow matter leaving the thinning disk.
expectation: Some exposed gas may disperse or escape from the disk, though the mechanism is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The fine grains may also leave the disk, but I will follow the gas first.

effect: Stellar radiation drives exposed gas into the surroundings; the fine grains remain to be followed.
reaction: The distinction between losing the disk's structure and retaining its material is useful.
reason: This is the only available gameplay action and follows the remaining fine grains.
expectation: The exposed grains may be carried away or dispersed as the disk thins, though their fate is uncertain.

effect: Radiation drives the exposed small grains outward; they can now meet the escaping gas.
reaction: The distinction between small grains and larger solids is useful.
reason: This is the only available gameplay action and follows the departing grains and gas together.
expectation: The grains and gas will mix into the star's surroundings, though their precise fate is uncertain.

effect: The grains and escaping gas mix into the surroundings, completing the remaining goal while the compact worlds remain.
reaction: It was satisfying to see disk material return to the larger galactic encounter.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the rocky world into the wider system was most worthwhile: it connected the tracked world and moon to the chapter's broader view.

leastWorthwhile.text: Following the gas and grains separately felt somewhat repetitive, although their different responses to radiation were informative.

surprise.text: The debris retained a link to the dry remains of the inward-moving icy body, bringing that earlier journey into the remnant belt.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the final combination was the only gameplay option rather than a meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the wider galactic encounter develops; this chapter's return of disk material to the surroundings makes that connection intriguing.
